summary: Provision time-limited searchable redacted log index to support customer SAR adjudication
description:
Issue summary:
A customer has submitted a Subject Access Request (SAR). Legal has requested a constrained, searchable index of production inference events that contains only redacted, hashed identifiers and limited context fragments to allow adjudication and evidence matching. The request must avoid exposing full prompt or response payloads and raw KV cache content.

Impact:
- Business: SAR must be responded to within statutory timelines; Legal requires usable artifacts to make a determination.
- Security/Privacy: High risk if unredacted PII is released. Must follow dual-control approval and KMS-wrapped storage.

Environment:
- Prod inference logs (us-east region). Index will be a derived artifact; no direct mount of raw logs.

Request details / acceptance criteria:
1) Produce a time-limited, encrypted S3 index (s3://redwood-prod-redacted-indexes/INT-765432/) containing: hashed user identifiers (HMAC-SHA256), event metadata (timestamp, model, route, token counts), and redacted 128-character context snippets (prompt/response fragments truncated and scrubbed by PII regex). No KV cache dumps, no full-text responses, no attachments.
2) Access control: IAM role assignment limited to Legal + Privacy engineers; require MFA; approval via Okta group and explicit JIRA approval.
3) Auditability: All reads/writes require CloudTrail and object-level access logs; access rationale must be recorded in ticket comments.
4) Timebox: 14-day TTL after provisioning; automatic lifecycle delete + secondary verification before deletion.
5) Technical guardrails: KMS key scoped to this artifact (alias/INT-765432), bucket policy forbidding public ACLs, object encryption required, and S3 block public access.
6) Sampling & verification: Before granting access, SRE/Data Governance will sample 10 random index records and Legal will confirm they do not contain recoverable PII.
7) Traceability: Provide mapping of index entries back to original log segments using non-reversible hash mapping and an internal proof artifact stored under secure HSM-only access for forensic review if required by regulators.

Approvals required: Legal (Lina Chen), Privacy (Marco Ruiz), InfoSec (Jillian Park), and SRE/Platform owner (Samir Patel).

Requested deadline: 2026-03-16 (to meet SAR timeline).

investigation_notes: Checked prod ingestion pipeline: logs retained in 'prod-inference-logs-us-east' for 30 days; can derive index without touching raw KV cache service.
Identified existing scrubber library under infra/tools/redaction that supports PII regexes and truncation; will extend with 128-char snippet cap.
Search index format considered: OpenSearch vs S3-indexed JSON. Chose S3 JSON lines with precomputed inverted token map for simpler access control and auditability.
HMAC salt will be stored in KMS and rotated following key-rotation cadence; mapping proof artifact will be sealed and only accessible by HSM-bound key under dual-control approval.
controls_and_mitigations: Dual-control approval required before any user is granted decryption access.
No raw payloads or KV caches included; snippets are truncated and redacted via vetted regexes.
All access logged in CloudTrail and recorded in this ticket; use of index requires adding an entry to 'data-access-logbook' confluence page.
Automated lifecycle deletion after 14 days; manual warden check prior to deletion to confirm no legal hold extension.
resolution: Pending InfoSec and Privacy signoff on final redaction regex set. Implementation plan approved by SRE; PR opened for scrubber + provisioning. Upon approvals, SRE will create bucket, KMS alias, run scrubber, sample 10 records for Privacy/Legal verification, and then grant timeboxed IAM role. Final artifact path and audit logs will be attached to this ticket.
